newsitem.title: USA: Dell, Newcourt form Dell Financial Services.
newsitem.headline: Dell, Newcourt form Dell Financial Services.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp and Newcourt Credit Group Inc of Toronto said Monday they formed Dell Financial Services LP (DFS) as a joint venture to offer a wide range of leasing and asset management services to Dell's customers in the United States and eventually worldwide.

Based in Round Rock, Texas, Dell Financial Services currently is being staffed with over 60 employees from both Dell and Newcourt. It is expected that the company's staff level will double within the next year, the companies said.

"The creation of DFS is a natural extension of Dell's highly successful direct business model and is a key part of our strategy to broaden the suite of value added services that we provide to our customers," said Michael Dell, chairman and chief executive of Dell Computer Corporation.

"Our partnership with Dell in creating DFS, is a significant step in keeping with Newcourt's strategy of building long term relationships with leading equipment manufacturers in growth industries serving the U.S. and international markets," said Steven Hudson, President and CEO of Newcourt Credit Group.

Dell said it selected Newcourt as its financial partner in the creation of DFS following a 12 month search, competition and evaluation process. The investment banking firm, Goldman, Sachs & Co provided advisory services to Dell in this process.
In addition to on-line access to financing provided by Newcourt CreditLink, DFS will also offer asset management services and will add new services and international markets in the future.
